answer_1.quote: We evaluate AutoTemplate across two tasks: keywords-to-sentence generation on One-Billion-Words and Yelp datasets ( §3.1), and entity-guided summarization on CNNDM and XSum datasets ( §3.2).

answer_2.quote: All performance is measured with the BLEU-2/4 , NIST-2/4 scores , and METEOR v1.5 . ... We evaluate the entity‑guided summarization performance using F1 scores of ROUGE-1/2/L ...

answer_3.quote: For the evaluation, we didn't have LLM-as-a-judge due to the budget constraint even though it shows a high correlation with human judgment .
